basic_info.description: San Francisco's architectural charm is revealed in this spacious and sunny detached home in the quiet and tranquil Balboa Terrace neighborhood. With this near perfect floor plan, you will start to envision a modern revival as you walk up to the 15-glass-pane door. Moving through the front entrance and into a foyer that guides you into 3 different directions, the formal living room with a beautiful marble fireplace, large dining room, or the 2 large bedrooms. A third bedroom is across the hall from the sunlit kitchen and separate breakfast area which are ideal to start your day off right. The basement has 2+ car parking, laundry & storage but lends itself to additional square footage by adding a room and bath. The front and enclosed back yard have matured landscaping. Walking distance to schools, shopping, restaurants, parks and public transportation for easy access to SFSU, SFCC, downtown and Silicon Valley.
